question_or_proposition: For Total Dissolved Solids at Outfall 001, do the 'Report' entries in all effluent limit columns establish report-only obligations with no enforceable numeric discharge limit, and does footnote *1 ('When discharging') condition the quarterly monitoring requirement such that monitoring applies only during periods when discharge from Outfall 001 occurs?
required_context: Section A, Final Effluent Limits – Outfall 001 – Intermittent Flow
DISCHARGE LIMITATIONS table structure distinguishing numeric limits from 'Report'
source_locator: aztec/final_permit.pdf, Page 3, Section part_i, Total Dissolved Solids row
notes: The nominated span pairs Report-only limit fields with 1/Quarter (*1) monitoring for TDS at an intermittent-flow outfall; resolving report-only versus numeric limit status affects Purpose A, and resolving the discharge-conditioning of *1 affects monitoring applicability (Purpose B) and how absent TDS results are classified during no-discharge periods (Purpose C).
